# HARDWARIO STEM

> STEM learning platform for schools with hands-on Internet-of-Things lessons and
> student projects built with the solder-free HARDWARIO TOWER kit. Ready-made
> courses, mini-courses and teaching materials. Published by HARDWARIO a.s.
> (Liberec, Czech Republic), which designs and manufactures the devices that
> bring industrial assets online. Available in English (default) and Czech
> (/cs/). Welcomes AI crawlers; the full page list is in the sitemaps below.

## Pages

- [HARDWARIO STEM in English (default)](https://stem.hardwario.com/): courses, mini-courses and teaching materials
- [HARDWARIO STEM in Czech](https://stem.hardwario.com/cs/): Czech version of the platform
- [TOWER mini-course](https://stem.hardwario.com/mini-course/): introductory hands-on IoT course
- [STEM lessons](https://stem.hardwario.com/stem/): structured classroom lessons and teaching guidance
- [Projects and tutorials](https://stem.hardwario.com/projects/): practical projects built around HARDWARIO TOWER
- [English sitemap](https://stem.hardwario.com/sitemap.xml): complete, machine-readable list of English pages
- [Czech sitemap](https://stem.hardwario.com/cs/sitemap.xml): complete, machine-readable list of Czech pages

## More from HARDWARIO

- [HARDWARIO Academy](https://hardwario.academy/): IoT lessons for schools on TOWER and a first pilot planned with the school
- [HARDWARIO](https://www.hardwario.com/): our devices, the applications built on them and HARDWARIO Cloud
- [HARDWARIO Documentation](https://docs.hardwario.com/): technical documentation of every device, TOWER included
